mapper.sql:
WHERE 1 = 1
AND (u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR p.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR d.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))
AND UPPER(u.role) = UPPER(#{query.role})
AND u.status = '正常'
AND u.status = '禁用'
AND u.status = #{query.status}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN patient p ON p.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN doctor d ON d.user_id = u.id

SELECT u.id, u.username, COALESCE(p.name, d.name, u.username) AS name, p.phone, UPPER(u.role) AS role, CASE u.status WHEN '正常' THEN 'NORMAL' WHEN '禁用' THEN 'DISABLED' ELSE u.status END AS status, u.create_time FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN patient p ON p.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN doctor d ON d.user_id = u.id
ORDER BY u.id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO operation_log ( operator_id, operation_type, action, target_type, target_id, target, reason, result ) VALUES ( #{adminId}, 'USER_STATUS', CASE #{action} WHEN '禁用' THEN 'DISABLE' ELSE 'RESTORE' END, 'USER', #{userId}, LEFT(CONCAT( '用户ID=', #{userId}, '，操作=', #{action}, CASE WHEN #{reason} IS NULL THEN '' ELSE CONCAT('，原因=', #{reason}) END ), 100), #{reason}, '成功' )
